body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月波蘭戰役期間，德軍以邊境指揮部的營、第62步兵師的一個團及第252步兵師部分單位組成特遣群，稱為吉南特群（Group Gienanth），負責防衛南方集團軍群暴露的左翼。來源只提到此群之名，未寫其指揮官全名與任期。
body.en: During the September 1939 Polish campaign, German frontier-command battalions, a regiment of the 62d Infantry Division and elements of the 252d Infantry Division were formed into a task force called Group Gienanth, responsible for defending Army Group South's exposed left flank. The source gives only the group's name, not its commander's full name or tenure.
